proposals.before: As the Tradition says: take Yao and Shun. When Yu, Ji, and Qi joined them in doing what was right, it was carried out; when Gun and Huan Dou sought to join them in wrongdoing, they were executed.
proposals.after: As the Tradition says: take Yao and Shun. When Yu, Ji, and Xie joined them in doing what was right, it was carried out; when Gun and Huan Dou sought to join them in wrongdoing, they were executed.
proposals.reason: Chinese 禼 is the sage-minister Xie (契), not Qi; translating as Qi confuses him with the state of Qi.

proposals.before: The Tradition says: For example, with Yao and Shun, when Yu, Ji, and Qi joined them in doing good, it was carried out; when Gun and Huan Dou wished to join them in doing evil, they were executed.
proposals.after: The Tradition says: For example, with Yao and Shun, when Yu, Ji, and Xie joined them in doing good, it was carried out; when Gun and Huan Dou wished to join them in doing evil, they were executed.
proposals.reason: Chinese 禼 is Xie (契); Qi is a mistranslation of that personal name.

decisions.reason: In 禹、稷、禼, 禼 is the sage-minister Xie (契), not Qi; replacing Qi with Xie corrects a real naming error without changing the rest of the sentence.
The Chinese personal name 禼 in 禹、稷、禼 is Xie (契); Qi is a mistranslation, and the proposed literal replacement is accurate.

claimRetractions.reason: The alternate English name Qi for 禼 was created only by the mistranslation; s0013 supports Xie, not Qi, as the English form of this personal name.
